verdict.rationale: Kintsugi documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants query its docs and live OpenAPI spec for accurate code generation, which is a real, first-party MCP integration point. However, it explicitly does not proxy API calls or expose credentials, so an agent connecting via this MCP server can only get documentation context, not perform actual tax actions—falling short of full agentic tool use. Missing for 10: evidence of the MCP server exposing callable API actions/tools (not just docs), and independent/hands-on confirmation of agent usage.
